notes.title: Patch 19.7
notes.notes:
Improved the support for Valve Index headsets and fixed a bug which prevented Vive controllers from being used concurrently with Index headsets.

NOTE: If you are still having trouble with Index controllers or Index setup in general, please post as detailed description as possible in the forum or send it directly to team(at)levityplay.com

Thank you and have fun!

notes.title: Patch 19.6
notes.notes:
A quick update with some cool additions!

- Added support for Valve Index controllers.
- Added support for HTC Vive Cosmos setup
- some smaller bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 19.5
notes.notes:
Several bug fixes:

- fixed a bug that prevented switching between different loadouts.
- fixed a bug with tutorial that caused the game to freeze.
- fixed a bug that awarded players with match end medals even if the value was 0.

NOTE: Since we added an arcade feature that enables all weapons in a single loadout, there might be some arcade hosted public matches where this feature will be enabled for all players. We're considering extending this feature as an option to all users, so please let us know on Discord or elsewhere if that's something you'd like to see in Skyfront VR.

notes.title: Patch 19.4
notes.notes: Added some new features to the arcade mode as well as fixed some minor bugs.

notes.title: Patch 19.3
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/ee82ae7e1f5ad0769e11d501fe41e2d96c5905de.png

Added several arcade features which should make it easier to run and customize Skyfront VR in arcade settings.

To learn more, please get in touch with us via team[at]levityplay.com or our Discord channel.

notes.title: Patch 19.2
notes.notes:
Updates in this patch:

NEW SKINS!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/864988b94e2875f3210818b30d81eea8711f8fe3.png

NEW VISORS!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/f817288dd0800136d793944e9c6a126db096b89b.png

notes.title: Patch 19.1
Patch 19 – RELEASE BUILD UPDATE
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/3297c271f6f1eb1a939f2c252d6905f1596ef27b.png

OHMYGOD! Skyfront uploaded its RELEASE BUILD! But wait, why does it look like we're still in EA? Well, Steam has it's rules and we want to abide by them, but we also want to give you our amazing game at a really good price during the holiday season... Long story short, the EA marker is a technicality and what you have here, ladies and gentlemen, is the Release Build of Skyfront VR! ːsteamhappyː The official transition from EA to Full Release will take place after the holiday season. 

So let's see what's new! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/bcc50b96700eabed76f4a3bd6577ed6345350882.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/b92b82bb0e47d4822eea0d5f151132b5dd827b4f.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/022b7c8542eb42234d206b5066139b34d9ca2c6f.jpg

Say hello to Genesis – our new space inspired arena! It's dark, it's mysterious and it's packed with fun! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/b2b458ece8bdb2bc0259aedef0b1d3acb084a501.jpg

The game now features a progression system that awards players XP as they gain more experience. Every time you level up, you unlock cosmetic items. 

This brings us to – customisation! You can choose between tons of unlockable skins, visors and trails to create your perfect VR you! Gain XP to unlock more items. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/004120e721e4be025f496c9f4c03293d022ba520.jpg

To thank everybody that backed us during our time in EA, we have created a special Founder's Pack. The Epic skin, two Epic visors and an Epic trail in the pack will ONLY be available to those that purchased Skyfront before 20 December 2018. Thank you, all! 

Minor fixes in the patch:

 The Pineapple has been nerfed from 40 to 20 damage per pellet. 
 If nobody votes during map vote, the game will continue on the same arena. 
 The player outline is now thinner and we scrapped it altogether in Single DM. 
 Visual fixes to the Egypt and Convent arenas. 
 A plethora of visual fixes in menus and the HUD. 


And to top it off, Skyfront is now also available on the Oculus store! With crossplatform gameplay, there will be tons more opponents to shoot at and immensely more fun to be had!

notes.title: Patch 18.5
notes.notes:
Good news! Based on player feedback, we've gone ahead and separated the US and EU regions. The game automatically places the player in their regional server – EU, US or Asia. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/a62723f2cc33b2e78c5eba4e749fa52577255a87.png

To change your region, simply click on GAME HUB to open the region menu on your right. You can then choose whichever region you prefer. 

If you're experiencing any problems with lag and ping, please do let us know on our Discord channel.

notes.title: Tournament App Update Patch
notes.notes:
Our most recent Tournament App patch fixes a memory leak bug that caused the App the lag and eventually crash during longer play sessions. 

Skyfront's Tournament App is intended for VR arcades and eSports event organsers. Read more about the App  here.

You can see the App in action during the upcoming Skyfront tournament organised by Virtual Athletics Leaguein collaboration with  Springboard VR.

notes.title: Patch 18 – New Convent Map, Domination Mode and Much More!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/98ffc90e2d96799f0a5ff8f2730ee209f529dfa5.png

Thank you guys for your patience!
Here it finally is, our map number three – the Convent!

The Convent is inspired by medieval architecture and was once the home of scribes and monks. The huge statues within the cathedral stand guard over this vast monument. On the outskirts of the Convent, you'll find cosy little huts and secret towers.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/98a99dc659deacbc7feb5762b9fd2c1f231e142e.jpg

Along with the third map, we've added a map vote. The prompt appears after every three games. The next game will take place on the map that won the majority vote. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/794931b56cff1b9ad6af71f76e93a2b072809aa1.png

The second huge addition in this patch is a third game mode – Domination. Battle the opposing team to gain and keep control of the three domination points on the map. The first team to get 250 points wins. 

We've also added a new custom on-screen keyboard to fix several usability issues with the native Steam VR keyboard.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/bafe9fcb7416aaa52ca3c10bfc7dfaef3da9b582.jpg

The patch brings a new health bar. The design of the health bar makes it easier to read from a distance. 

The bots have been nerfed and now shoot less often and miss more. We're hoping we've hit a good balance now but please do let us know if the bots still feel a bit OP. 

Finally, a server migration notification was added to inform the players of a server migration. 

Coming up next – Steam Workshop!

notes.title: Patch 17 – GIANT UPDATE
notes.notes:
Buckle up, cause we're back with a giant patch of goodies for you! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/81d889af165935678cf940870cbfc771d3c327af.png

The biggest change you'll notice the second you launch Skyfront is our new UI! We've given everything from the main menu to the in-game menus a proper face-lift! The new UI is more sleek, improves UX and oozes of esports polish! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/05fc8296ec92a67941a43d323ea2f3d757c15481.jpg

We've also added a HUD that displays the player's HP, game time and score according to the game mode. You can customise the HUD as well as the hand display – which has also been revamped – from the Options menu.
Now you can also choose, which hand you want the display to appear on. Heck, you can even have it on both hands! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/6507ae77c5e32c8a5f881698bcb70af54c5c4a31.jpg

This patch also brings an addition to the special abilities available to you in Skyfront. Say hello to Jammer! The new ability jams the special abilities of all of your opponents in a 50 m radius for 6 seconds. Yes, we mean all special abilities, even a shockwave that's already heading your way! Look out Shield abusers! 

Skyfront now also has music! We worked with composed Arian Levin to add some atmosphere to the menu and game end and beginning sequences. We're very proud of how it turned out! 

Some minor updates include optimising the rocket and grenade explosions, which should help with the visual lag some players experienced when a lot of explosions went off at once. 

The Shield effect has been updated and polished. 

Adaptive weapon switch mapping is now optional and is set to disabled in the Options menu by default. 

And to conclude this patch, we fixed a bug on the Egypt level that caused a number of effects, e.g. the fire and explosions to become transparent at times due to the skybox shaders.

notes.title: Patch 16
notes.notes:
Today's patch 16 includes a number of cool updates that make your experience in Skyfront a ton sleeker and more streamlined!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/e2dec62cea141654411b6ed2d92d8069576eb55f.png

Team Deathmatch mode was long overdue for some TLC.
The Team Deatchmatch game mode now allows players to select their team. When you join Team Deathmatch, you will be asked, which team you want to join. As long as the match hasn't started, you have two additional chances to switch teams. Mid-match team changes will not be possible. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/903aa5fc8787a35206c43f236ca620ca5d45e458.png

This patch brings a redesigned death screen, which now tells you both the name of your killer, as well as the weapon that killed you. In addition, the death screen will display your current killstreak, should you have gone on one. 

Another major update concerns the weapon switch. When you have one weapon equipped, you can click on either side of the scrollwheel to bring up the other weapon. We hope the carousel weapon switch will make it easier and quicker to switch weapons mid-game. 

To tweak the meta, we buffed the Locust minigun. A single bullet now does 30 HP damage, instead of the former 20. In addition, the bullet spread when you have the gun equipped with both hands has now been reduced to 0. 

To top it off, the Gamehub match list now displays active match hosts instead of the original match creators. 

And one bug fix as well: 
- Removed a bug that caused the volume to go all the way down whenever a player changed the volume settings in-game.

notes.title: Patch 15
Major Updates in Patch 14
Skyfront Skirmish: Shockwave Showdown + Patch 13
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/b3c2eaecf3ca3d23f05cb19c4430dd8a44ac5f04.jpg

Patch 13 Brings You the New and Improved Shockwave and a Ton of Overdue Bug Fixes

The star of Patch 13 and this weekend's Skirmish is our Shockwave special ability. Did you know that the underrated Shockwave does a whopping 180 HP of damage? To make it even better, Shockwave now shoots through walls! And as the cherry on top, we also pumped the speed of the Shockwave from 50 m/s up to 75 m/s! 

Since it turns out that we greatly miscalculated how long it takes for someone to grab a glass of soda or tell their dog to stop eating the headset's wires (again!), we upped the AFK detector's wait-time from 30 seconds to 3 minutes. 

In this patch, our professional exterminators got rid of the following bugs: 
[olist]
Say byebye to the networking bug that froze the voice chat settings after the host left the match;
And to the networking bug that reset the player's score after the host left the match;
Got rid of a minigun muzzle VFX preload bug that caused a slight delay when the minigun was used for the first time;
The skybox on the Egypt map now properly renders in the Sniper Rifle's scope;
And the Shield hitbox problem that left the character vulnerable in extreme positions has also been removed – You can now stretch and jump as much as you want, safely tucked away in your Shield's hitbox.
[/olist]

Skyfront Skirmish: Shockwave Showdown  
March 9th 8 PM UTC until March 12th 5 AM UTC
Shockwave Showdown is our first Skirmish dedicated to a special ability. In this week’s update, we pumped the Shockwave up to penetrate walls! Aim the Shockwave the same way you aim with any of the weapons – just point in the direction you want to blast the Shockwave. Even if your opponent thinks they’re super sneaky by hiding behind a wall, you know better! Send those waves rippling and may the King or Queen of the Shockwave be crowned by the end of this Skirmish!   

Date and Time
Skyfront Skirmish: Shockwave Showdown will begin Friday March 9th at 8 PM UTC and end Monday March 12th at 5 AM UTC.

Prizes
First place – $ 50 Steam gift card 
Second place – $ 25 Steam gift card
Third place – $ 10 Steam gift card

Rules
[olist]
Players will compete for the most kills with the Shockwave special ability during a single Deathmatch game.
Your death count will not affect your chance of winning – we are only looking at your kills with the Shockwave special ability.
A player’s high score with the Shockwave will be registered at the end of the game or when the player exits the game.
You may use other weapons and special abilities, but only the kills you make using the Shockwave will be counted towards your high score.
Players are forbidden from teaming up and assisting each other or using bugs or glitches with the intention of getting a better high score.
Abusive behaviour will not be tolerated in-game, especially in VOIP – keep it friendly!
The high scores will be counted for games with a minimum of 3 players at the start of the game. NOTE! If the game starts with three players and two players leave before the end of the game, the high score of the last remaining player will be locked the moment the second to last player leaves the game.
The winners are the players with the top three highest scores at the end of the Skirmish. 
Arcade accounts are excluded from the Skirmishes (see Important Notes below).
Prizes will be awarded at the end of the Skirmish.
Skyfront will attempt to contact the winners of the Skirmishes, but to guarantee that you get your due prize asap, please contact the devs on Skyfront’s social media or Discord channel. 
[/olist]

Important Notes
High scores from arcades will not be included in the Skirmishes. Separate events will be organised for arcades. That being said, arcade players are still more than welcome to join in on the Skirmishes, but their scores will not be counted towards anything. 

All Skyfront Skirmishes will be moderated to ensure no one is cheating or breaking any rules. 

Skyfront Skirmish – Overview
Skyfront Skirmishes are weekend challenges that Skyfront organises every couple of weeks. During each Skirmish, players will compete for a certain high score (e.g. most kills, best multikill, killstreak, most kills with a certain weapon, etc.) that will be announced the week of the event. Play time is limited to the duration of the Skirmish and all weapons and special abilities are allowed, unless stated otherwise (e.g. if the Skirmish is devoted to a specific weapon).

Each future Skyfront Skirmish and the prizes of future Skirmishes will be announced separately. 

If you love the Skirmishes or have any suggestions for what we could do better or differently, give us devs a shoutout on our Discord channel at https://discord.gg/kkh6qag.

notes.title: Update to Yesterday's Patch
Update to Yesterday's Patch
Tiny Interim Patch
notes.notes:
If you're on our Discord channel (join here https://discord.gg/kkh6qag) or follow us on Facebook, you already know that we are launching a new challenge series, Skyfront Skirmish, on Friday January 26th. In preparation for the challenge series, we made a few quick fixes and a minor update. 

Fixes:
- Leaderboard fix;
- A statistics bug that caused your average position to stay unchanged;
- Also fixed some server lag problems. 

In addition, we are introducing an afk detector that will display a warning when a player has remained inactive for 30 seconds. If the player has been inactive for 40 seconds, he/she will be removed from the game. 

Stay tuned for the rules and other details regarding Skyfront Skirmish!

notes.title: Tiny Interim Patch
notes.notes:
If you're on our Discord channel (join here https://discord.gg/kkh6qag) or follow us on Facebook, you already know that we are launching a new challenge series, Skyfront Skirmish, on Friday January 26th. In preparation for the challenge series, we made a few quick fixes and a minor update. 

Fixes:
- Leaderboard fix;
- A statistics bug that caused your average position to stay unchanged;
- Also fixed some server lag problems. 

In addition, we are introducing an afk detector that will display a warning when a player has remained inactive for 30 seconds. If the player has been inactive for 40 seconds, he/she will be removed from the game. 

Stay tuned for the rules and other details regarding Skyfront Skirmish!

notes.title: December update vol 1
notes.notes:
Hey, a semi-quick update! 

We’ve been plowing on with new developments for Skyfront VR. Today, as promised, we're adding some features to make it easier to find and create matches.

- GAME HUB. You can now access match list straight from the Main Menu by selecting Play>Game Hub.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/3bb1cb962a798a11fcbc1a2dfeeb74973997ad59.jpg

- WEAPON PROMPT. We added a holographic prompt to show you the weapons and key bindings are currently active. NOTE: You can disable this feature in the options menu.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30211483/e759e6720bceca5f0bc26588422eb3c7f78e2621.jpg

- Revolver NERF! Due to community feedback we nerfed revolver damage from 100HP to 90HP. That means you can no longer one-shot your unfortunate opponents. Double headshot should still do the trick though!

Bug fixes:

- Reaching into a wall with the controller would allow you to shoot through it, leading to some very unfair kills with the sniper rifle. No longer. Fixed!
- Sometimes changes in loadouts wouldn’t save - Fixed!
- In case of leaving the match and going back to the Main Menu, the pointer would sometimes disappear - Fixed!
- Sometimes players weren’t able to re-join a match after the host migration - Fixed!
- Automatic Rifle reload animation issues after a weapon swap during reload animation - Fixed!
- Changed Automatic Rifle recoil to constant instead of cumulative animation.
- Fixed “Killed by…” tag visibility issue. It will now always face you as you move around.
- A player starting a match in Egypt map would be briefly positioned inside the pyramid floor - Fixed!


Next up, a personal User Profile with detailed gameplay statistics (wins, kills, deaths, k/d ratio etc), updates to the game menu and a special Christmas surprise.
We will also be announcing a COMMUNITY EVENT, the first on many, which will make better use of our current leaderboard and give players an equal chance to come up on top. Also, some sweet rewards!
In the meantime, get back to us on Discord, Facebook and Steam Community and let us know your thoughts on updates as well as what cool features we should be working on next!

notes.title: November update
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

We've been busy as hell and are excited to release our first Early Access update.

- Added recoil to all weapons! For some it's purely cosmetical, adding to the realness of using a weapon. For Revolver, Shotgun and Sniper Rifle it also works as a nerf. Each shot is followed by a vertical offset, which makes it harder to score several hits in quick succession, a method that more experienced players were quick to exploit.
- Shotgun has been buffed. Amount of bullets per shot is up from 10 to 16, damage per bullet reduced from 30 to 20 HP, reload time reduced from 2 secs to 1,5 secs.
- Added support for WINDOWS MIXED REALITY headset! Remapped the controls to the joystick so everything should work same as on Oculus.
- Lot's of updates to the Egypt map, including graphical optimizations and replacing missing collision boxes.
- Team Deathmatch max size is now 5v5, instead of 3v3.
- Bots now react to Stealth and X-ray special abilities, ie Stealth makes the player invisible to bots and X-ray reveals the location of all bots on the map. 

We also fixed several bugs:
- A bug where a shotgun trails remained in the air when shot close to a shield or a map dome.
- A bug where revolver became stuck after rapid firing and would only work again after a respawn.
- A bug with the game stats window which in some cases continued to show results from a previous match.
- some other minor fixes to the menu and maps.

Our next update will focus on accessibility, making it easier to learn the controls and finding and creating matches. We also have some bigger updates in store. In the meantime, check out the new features and let us know what you think on Discord, Facebook and Steam Community. We'll be listening and playing with you!
